newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Shipping - Grain/oilseed cargoes - April 17.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Shipping - Grain/oilseed cargoes - April 17.

text.p: The following is the berthing schedule for major bulk vessels unloading at Taiwan's main grain ports at Taichung and Kaohsiung, as detailed on Thursday by Taiwanese surveyors:
The discharging cargoes are given in tonnes. Berthing dates are for arrival in port/expected completion of discharge.
Corn 55,700 New Hurzon CK Group April 09/17
Wheat 8,600 Anangel Hunesty Flour Ass April 18/23
Incoming Taiwan grain/oilseed shipments in tonnes with scheduled dates of arrival. K is Kaohsiung; T is Taichung.
Taiwan also has bulk offloading facilities at Keelung.
